name: gouache
description: Opaque paint, drier than watercolour: flat matte shapes with a chalky bloom where the pigment settled, and one shape painted over another because it covers.

prompt.default: a gouache painting: opaque matte colour in flat shapes, chalky and slightly blooming, one shape painted over another because the paint covers, soft settled edges and no shine
prompt.flux: a gouache illustration, opaque matte pigment in flat clearly separated shapes, chalky bloom where it dried, later shapes painted over earlier ones, a soft dry edge, no gloss
prompt.sdxl: gouache painting, opaque matte flat colour, chalky, poster-like, soft edges, painterly
